title: The Feud
start: Talk to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid.

items.t: Desert disguise (buy Kharidian headpiece and fake beard from Ali's Discount Wares or the Pollnivneach General Store to make it)
At least 1,000 coins (a ring of charos will reduce the cost of carpet rides)
A pair of leather gloves (can be replaced by combat gloves)
A bucket (there are two bucket spawns in Sami the Camel Man's shop)
3 beer (can be purchased from Faisal the Barman)
If you have already obtained red hot sauce from Isma'il the Kebab seller, he will not give you another one. Therefore, you need to bring the red hot sauce he already gave you.

recommended.t: Equipment to kill two champions. If the fights are worrisome, bring some food and/or a few prayer potions and/or a ring of life
A few waterskins (if you plan to walk to Pollnivneach)
Broomstick or amulet of glory (for faster teleports to Shantay Pass)
The Pollnivneach General Store and Ali's Discount Wares at the quest start sells most of the items needed

rewards.t: The ability to do another part of Rogue Trader
Free beer when telling Faisal the Barman about Traitorous Hesham's drink being poisoned.

steps.t: Talk to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid. [Chat: 1 If you are, then why are you still selling goods from a stall? › 2 I'd like to help you but.... › Accept › 1 No, I'm really too busy.]

sub.t: If you do not have desert disguise, [Chat: 1 If you are, then why are you still selling goods from a stall? › 2 I'd like to help you but.... › Accept › 2 Okay.] buy Kharidian headpiece and fake beard from the shop and then use these items on each other.

steps.t: Travel to south Pollnivneach (talk to the rug merchant just outside Shantay Pass to get there using a magic carpet).
Head to the local bar.

sub.t: If you do not have three glasses of beer, talk to Faisal the Barman to buy them. [Chat: 1 Yes, I'd like a drink please.]

steps.t: Right-click to use three glasses of beer on Jalal the Drunk. Finish the dialogue with each beer.
Talk to a Menaphite Thug, who can be found inside the bar or outside the west side of the bar. Make sure to right-click to avoid attacking him.
Talk to a brigand or bandit in the North Pollnivneach. Again, right-click to talk to him.
Head to the kebab seller north-west of the well in the town centre. The map icon is .
Talk to Isma'il the Kebab seller to buy red hot sauce from him. [Chat: 3 Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce? › 2 No thanks, I'm good.]

In the house immediately to the south-west, talk to Sami the Camel Man to ask for two camels. Offer 500 coins. [Chat: 4 Are those camels around the side for sale? › 2 What price do you want for both of them? › 3 Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?]
Use the red hot sauce on a trough in the pen west of the camel shop.
Pick up the dung with a bucket in the backpack if the dung is brown. If it is green, use more sauce on a trough until it is brown.

sub.t: 2 empty buckets can be found in the camel shop.
Obtain more buckets of dung if you plan to complete Dealing with Scabaras (1 bucket, does not consume) and My Arm's Big Adventure (3 buckets).

steps.t: Talk to a Menaphite Thug to the south to give them one of the camel receipts.
Talk to a brigand or bandit to the north to give them the other receipt.
Go south-west of Pollnivneach to a big purple tent and talk to Rashid the Operator to join his gang. [Chat: 1 Yes, of course, those bandits should be taught a lesson. › 2 No thanks.]
Attempt to pickpocket a villager. You will fail and take 20 damage.
Talk to Rashid the Operator for advice. [Chat: 1 Yeah, I could do with a bit of advice. › 2 No thanks.]
Talk to the street urchin near the well or the fountain. Pay him ten coins and then pickpocket the villager with an arrow over their head. You will fail again and take 20 damage.
Talk to Rashid the Operator. [Chat: 1 Yeah, I could do with a bit of advice.]
Wield the oak-blackjack.
Lure a villager into a secluded area. Knock out the villager with the blackjack and pickpocket them.
Talk to Rashid the Operator.
Wear the desert disguise and gloves.
Hide-behind the cactus near the mayor's house next to the fountain.

sub.t: The disguise and the gloves can be safely unequipped after this step.

steps.t: Use the keys on the door. If lost, talk to Rashid the Operator for another.
Climb the staircase on the northern side.
Search the landscape picture near the bed.
Move the dial to 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 in that order clockwise. Right-click the dials to help with the numbers. Click the centre square button will reset the mechanism.
p: A player playing the snake charm

steps.t: Talk to to Rashid the Operator to give the jewels.
Talk to a Menaphite Thug.
Talk to Rashid the Operator. [Chat: 2 No thanks.]
Talk to Faisal the Barman. [Chat: 3 I'm looking for Traitorous Hesham. › 1 No thanks I'm ok.]
Right-click to talk to Badir the Snake Charmer sitting south of the bar. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Right-click to use the snake charm on a desert snake north of the Menaphite tent and wait until it goes into the snake basket to become a full snake basket.

sub.t: If Badir the Snake Charmer did not give you a snake basket, it may be in your bank or talk to him again. [Chat: 1 Wow, a snake charmer. Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?.]

p: Using the poison on the drink

steps.t: Talk to Maysa the Hag, in the house north-west of the bar, on the hill.
Talk to Maysa the Hag the second time to give her the full snake basket and ugthanki dung respectively.
Use the Hag's poison on the table in the bar. It is the square one with a glass of beer on it, not the one with the empty beer glass.
Talk to Rashid the Operator.
Talk to the Menaphite Leader. Located outside the tent.
Kill the Tough Guy.
Talk to a villager. [Chat: 2 Ok I'll get to it.]
Talk to the Bandit Leader east of the northern magic carpet station. The Bandit Leader will not appear if you did not talk to the villager in the previous step.
Kill the Bandit champion.
p: Fighting the bandit champion in a safe spot

steps.t: Talk to a villager.
Talk to Hakeem the Mayor located next to the well in the middle of the town.
Return to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid.
Quest complete!
